summary: Both printed pages match the August 2024 PDF structure; needs form-local tweaks for Page 2 Tax Filer's Last Name mapping, empty Spouse TIN dashes, Part I Col A/B font sizing, and Page 2 Part V Items 7 & 9 microscopic specify text, plus shared print fixes for comb overflow.

defects.where: Page 1, Part I Item 6 B. Spouse TIN
defects.what: Empty spouse TIN prints '---00000' instead of staying blank.

defects.where: Page 1, Part I Items 8, 9, 10 and 18 (Column A vs Column B)
defects.what: Text in Column A (Taxpayer/Filer) shrinks noticeably smaller than equivalent text in Column B (Spouse), e.g., Contact Number and Email Address.

defects.where: Page 1 Part II Items 25, 27, 29, 30 and Page 2 Part IV.B1 Items 9, 10C, 10D, 12, 13, 14
defects.what: Negative or >8-digit amounts overflow the 8-slot comb boxes and render as left-aligned plain text colliding directly with comb tick marks.
Prints the entire full taxpayer name instead of only the last name, overflowing the comb boxes and colliding with the comb tick marks.

defects.where: Page 2, Part V Items 7 and 9 (Foreign Tax Credits and Other Tax Credits specify boxes)
defects.what: Specify text renders at a microscopic font size (~3.5pt) pinned near the top of the cell.

defects.where: Page 2, bottom reference tables (Table 1 ATCs and Table 2 Tax Rates)
defects.what: Reference tables are moved out of the filed sheet into guide.html per provenance.json.

defects.where: Part I, Item 6 Taxpayer Identification Number (TIN) - A. Taxpayer/Filer
defects.what: 5-digit branch code ('00000') truncates with an ellipsis ('000...') inside the read-only TIN branch box.

shared_changes_wanted: crates/bir-print (owned by neon-4 on try/forms-shared-print): mask comb ticks under overflowing negative/large amounts in Part II and Part IV.B1.
nsh/screens/form/ (shared screen code): widen read-only 5-digit TIN branch code box so '00000' does not truncate to '000...' on 1701MS.
open_questions: Print preview window opens natively on Linux via WebKitGTK; full unclipped 1400px-wide print-p*.png pages were rendered from the running app's generated sheet.html via headless Chrome --print-to-pdf + pypdfium2.
